card.name: The word see in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "see" right after an opening bracket at the end of a sentence in a drug label. It introduces a cross-reference to another section, such as Adverse Reactions or Warnings and Precautions.

modes.label: Bracketed see before section name
modes.description: "see" opens a bracketed pointer to another label section with its number.
